scope: Actual WBNB and PancakeSwap V2 on a local BNB fork. OpenFour settlement uses the labelled CoreHarness.

tests.title: keeps deployed bytecode within the EVM limit and binds the original supply
charges 5 percent buys and 10 percent fresh exits on launch day, day 20 and day 365 without double tax
keeps mature acquisitions on top-up and consumes fresh PI first
taxes wallet moves, resets recipient age and preserves self/zero transfers
never grants a lower fee or eligibility early across midnight
divides a finite pot 2:1 between equal mature and newly qualified holdings
normalizes mature weights and creates no liability from elapsed time
reserves the entire empty-holder bucket and denies retrospective rewards to later acquisitions
preserves earned BNB after exit and falls back to WBNB for rejecting recipients
blocks claim reentrancy and preserves unpaid debt when native withdrawal fails
conserves cumulative 70/15/10/5 budgets and rejects unauthorized or cross-bucket spending
seeds real PancakeSwap liquidity at the terminal curve ratio and preserves holding ages
charges real DEX buys 5 percent and fresh sells 10 percent
reaches the 1 percent DEX floor after a month
leaves exits live when treasury processing has no current oracle
executes real fee conversion, buyback/burn and locked liquidity with segregated budgets
rejects premature oracle updates and oversized treasury swaps
bounds cohort storage and measures a crowded transfer and distribution
validates LP inventory and component bindings
preserves ledger balances, supply and backing across 160 randomized EVM actions
matches every daily rate and weight in the independently specified frontend model
settles dormant cohort history identically to active claims across two years
rejects treasury execution after a large spot-price displacement
graduates with an unsolicited quote donation without a stuck migration

limits: No public transaction or deployed PI address.
Production OpenFour Core/FeeRouter/Registry integration and independent security audit remain required.
Measured gas cases are not a proof of global worst-case gas.
